ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: Routine business email drafting with no distasteful content involved. Plover is the stronger model across all benchmarks and internal evals (e.g., Creative Generation 84.7 vs 82.7, IFEval 89.8 vs 85.3), and since cost and latency are identical, the higher-capability model is the clear choice. Avocet's self-reported aversion to open-ended generative work isn't a capability factor, but there's no reason to prefer it here either.
